messages:
Marta: follow-up from today's postmortem. recurring OOMs after ~48h on inference workers. root suspects: shard resident growth + fragmentation. we need owners and short timelines so this doesn't slip.

Marta: proposed actions (claim please):
  1) quick heap sampling + jemalloc stats across canaries (owner?) ETA 48-72h
  2) emergency TTL enforcement hotfix if LRU metadata not expiring (owner?) ETA 24h
  3) background non-blocking eviction soft-cap per shard (owner?) ETA 5d
  4) small GC/fragmentation benchmark + malloc_conf pilot (owner?) ETA 10d
  5) dashboard + sustained-drift alert (owner?) ETA 3d

Devon: I'll take 1) and 2). can get sampling job up in 24h and validate TTL behavior. starting with pprof snapshots on canaries.

Riley: I'll pick 3) and 4). eviction will be background-only and emit metrics; malloc_conf pilot behind a flag. microbench will live in infra/perf.

Marta: thanks. Devon paste the capture commands so SRE can wire a job.

Devon: gist (full script in ticket):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c 'jemalloc-config --stats' > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
will attach job link to INF-1901.

oncall-bot: scheduled JOB-1901 to collect heap samples across selected canaries. next run in 5m.

Riley: eviction design note: soft-cap evicts only when shard resident > working_set + 20% for >15m. eviction runs in background with a token bucket. will add counters and a histogram for eviction latency.

Marta: good. emergency path: if DEV confirms TTL mismatch, push hotfix to canary and monitor. set an automatic rollback if memory > 2x baseline within 30m.

Devon: initial sampling shows a few shards with steady +30MB/day growth and LRU entries not aging after warmup. I'll try a TTL enforcement patch and report back 6-12h after canary.

sre-bot: created ticket INF-1901 "shard memory drift follow-up" and linked incident. assignees: Devon, Riley, Marta.

Marta: scheduling a 20m sync in 48h to review heap deltas and canary results. please update INF-1901 with PR links and telemetry screenshots.

Devon: will upload pprof snapshots and a short summary to INF-1901 once first pass is done.

Riley: opening a draft PR for eviction logic tonight; will link when ready.

Marta: awesome. closing the loop here 3: mark tasks in the ticket as they finish so we can close the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
